messages.subject: R1050 K staging decision report complete
messages.body: Audited the pinned QSA K staging map and wrote a source-only decision report comparing the current scattered global loads with blocked/vector and collective alternatives. The smallest candidate preserves BF16 bits, selected-ID/tail behavior, the  SLM consumer layout, score stride, matrix order, FP32 state, and barriers; transaction, cache, and SLM-bank effects remain hardware unknowns. Main still owns the isolated component and whole-model comparisons after the active cohort closes; no implementation or measurements were performed.
